title: bbox_render scope=global silently writes pod-local provider files on the cage daemon
wanted_capability: A global render on a zero-authority daemon either delivers the managed provider-file regions to the operator's interactive hosts or refuses; it must never report success while writing files nobody reads. Needs a target policy (which hosts receive global renders) and a delivery lane (the checkout-mutation backchannel shape fits, but targets are per-host home files, not one checkout).
evidence: src/tools/render.rs global arm writes cfg.paths.global_* targets
